description: Build Telegram t.me profile links and share links with pre-filled text from any username or channel name.

faqs.a: t.me is Telegram's official short domain. t.me/username opens that user, bot or channel directly in the app or web client.
Type the username without the @. The tool strips it automatically if you include it.
The share link (t.me/share/url) opens Telegram's share sheet with your text pre-filled, letting the user pick who to send it to.
faqs.q: What is the share link for?

faqs.a: Yes — everything is generated locally in your browser.

howto: Enter a Telegram username, channel or bot name.
Add an optional message for the share link.
Copy the profile link, the share link, or open them to test.
title: Telegram Link Generator
